---
title: "ADBC backend"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The stable default transfer path uses DBI/RPostgres.
The optional *experimental* ADBC path can stream Arrow batches directly from PostgreSQL, but it depends on local driver builds and SSL support, which the CRAN version of `adbcpostgresql` does not provide.

```{r}
library(db2pq)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
adbc_diagnostics()
wrds_update_pq("dsi", "crsp", transfer_method = "adbc")
```

If the ADBC path reports an SSL/libpq error, use `transfer_method = "dbi"` or
use an ADBC PostgreSQL driver that is built against an SSL-capable `libpq`.
WRDS requires SSL, and the stable WRDS path remains DBI/RPostgres.
